info.title: QEXPRESS Delivery API
info.description:
Create and track QEXPRESS deliveries, calculate shipping costs, download labels, and request returns.

## Authentication
Send your API key as `Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY` (without `Bearer`). Send JSON requests with `Content-Type: application/json`.

## Get started
Use the lookup endpoints to get your area and currency IDs, then create a delivery with `POST /api/delivery_request`. Optional store phones and coordinates are also accepted. Optional receiver fields include `receiver_otp`, `receiver_verify_link`, and the latitude/longitude pair.

Examples use illustrative values. Confirm your API environment and enabled endpoints with QEXPRESS.

post.description: Creates one express/local order under the authenticated user commercial customer. Shipper area and destination area are different fields: shipper_details.area_id is optional pickup origin; top-level area_id is required destination. Omitting shipper area uses the customer saved area (or empty if none). Store name is optional. COD requires an active currency and a strictly positive whole amount. Box count must match boxes.length. All example IDs are illustrative; retrieve real IDs using lookup routes. The response includes 10×15 label data. Unique internal_tracking_number is recommended for reconciling retries; this endpoint has no general idempotency key. Current product requirements vary with the portal extension; see CreateProduct. Optional receiver_latitude and receiver_longitude save a receiver destination map pin. Both must be present as numeric values when using a pin; latitude must be -90..90 and longitude -180..180. Both zero values are valid. The Delivery Order shows the pin beside the receiver address with a map link.

Calculates express/local pricing without creating any persistent delivery, pickup, invoice or label. This is the implemented quotation route; /api/delivery_request/totals is not implemented in the current local source. Only listed quotation fields are accepted. Currency and COD amount are optional here; when supplied for COD the amount must be a positive whole number. No matching contract/rule returns 422. Example totals illustrate shape, not a price offer.

example.message: Delivery totals calculated successfully. No order was created.

get.description: Find a shipment by barcode/name, business sequence or internal tracking number. Returns actual current state plus a seven-step progress display and newest-first delivery attempts. The request uses no JSON body. Progress display may represent a fallback step while current_status.code retains the actual state. Attempt dates are stored UTC without a suffix.

get.description: Returns a 10×15 shipping label for an existing order. Accepts barcode/name, business sequence or internal tracking number. Creates a return for a Delivered or Partially Returned order, confirms it and creates its reverse delivery. An existing active return yields 409. Return reasons are customer_refused, damaged, wrong_item, partial_return and other. The lookup accepts original barcode/name or sequence, not an internal tracking reference. Optional area_id changes the reverse order destination. A failure during confirmation should be reconciled before retrying because current error handling can leave a draft return behind.

post.description: Read Status and Delivery Status for one or more shipment numbers. Send a JSON array directly, or an object with shipment_numbers. Maximum 500 entries. Each entry must be a non-empty string. Matches shipment_number (barcode), not internal_tracking_number. Results preserve order and duplicates. Missing or inaccessible shipments return found=false without failing the batch. Uses the authenticated commercial customer, allowed companies and delivery-mode restrictions. This endpoint does not create or update shipments. All shipment identifiers and status combinations in these examples are fictional.

200.description: Per-shipment status results, including missing entries.

400.description: Invalid JSON, invalid entry, empty array or more than 500 entries.

example.message: Every shipment number must be a non-empty string.

ApiKeyAuth.name: Authorization
ApiKeyAuth.description: Raw QEXPRESS/Odoo RPC API key. No Bearer prefix. Never paste a real key into a saved specification.

ErrorData.description: Optional endpoint-specific validation details. Other fields may be present.

phone.description: Receiver phone number as text; preserve leading zeros and country prefix.

latitude.description: Optional nested alias for receiver_latitude. Supply a latitude/longitude pair. Top-level receiver_latitude takes precedence when present.

longitude.description: Optional nested alias for receiver_longitude. Supply a latitude/longitude pair. Top-level receiver_longitude takes precedence when present.

area_id.description: Optional pickup/shipper area. This is NOT the destination area. Takes precedence over top-level shipper_area_id when both are truthy; otherwise falls back to the customer saved area.

address.description: Optional shipper address; takes precedence over shipper_address when non-empty.

ShipperDetails.description: Optional shipper/pickup location. Omit this object to use the authenticated commercial customer saved area. If no saved area exists the value remains empty; shipper address has no automatic fallback in this handler.

piece_product_code.description: Recommended integration product code. Supply it for compatibility with deployments without the portal extension.

quantity.description: Product quantity. Send a finite positive value.

unit_price.description: Recommended product unit price. Current portal-enabled helper defaults omission to 0; deployments without that extension require this field.

CreateProduct.description: Current local portal-enabled deployment requires description and quantity. Always include piece_product_code and unit_price in customer integrations. The quotation endpoint has its own stricter product schema.

piece_product_code.description: Recommended integration product code. Supply it for compatibility with deployments without the portal extension.

quantity.description: Product quantity. Send a finite positive value.

unit_price.description: Finite non-negative product unit price; required for quotations.

length.description: Finite non-negative length. Use the measurement units configured for your QEXPRESS account.

width.description: Finite non-negative width. Use the measurement units configured for your QEXPRESS account.

height.description: Finite non-negative height. Use the measurement units configured for your QEXPRESS account.

weight.description: Finite non-negative weight. Use the measurement units configured for your QEXPRESS account.

Box.description: One physical box. Dimensions and weight are required. The create handler currently checks non-negativity; quote additionally rejects non-finite values. Use ordinary finite JSON numbers only.

store_name.description: Optional store name. Omitted, null or blank is saved empty. Non-string non-null values return 400.

area_id.description: Required receiver/destination area. Obtain the ID from GET /api/areas/{country_id}.

expected_delivery_datetime.description: Local wall-clock time in the API user timezone, falling back to company timezone settings and then Asia/Amman. Do not include an offset. It is converted to UTC internally.

is_same_day_delivery.description: Required, including when false. Send a JSON boolean, not a string.

currency_id.description: Required for COD; optional for prepaid. Currency must exist and be active. Prepaid omission uses the company currency.

cod_amount.description: Required for COD, strictly positive and without decimals. The selected currency digits_number configuration can limit the number of digits. Ignored for prepaid.

num_of_boxes.description: Required unless number_of_boxes is supplied. Must equal boxes.length.

number_of_boxes.description: Legacy alias for num_of_boxes. Prefer num_of_boxes. If both are present num_of_boxes takes precedence.

internal_tracking_number.description: Optional unique customer tracking/reference number. Duplicate saved values return 409. No general idempotency key is supported.

internal_awb_number.description: Alias for internal_tracking_number. The internal_tracking_number value takes precedence when non-empty.

receiver_latitude.description: Optional receiver destination latitude. Send both receiver coordinates together as JSON numbers, or omit/null both. Zero is valid. Saved with seven decimal places. This top-level field takes precedence over receiver_details.latitude.

receiver_longitude.description: Optional receiver destination longitude. Send both receiver coordinates together as JSON numbers, or omit/null both. Zero is valid. Saved with seven decimal places. This top-level field takes precedence over receiver_details.longitude.

receiver_otp.description: Optional receiver verification code. Send as text to preserve leading zeros. Omitted, null or blank saves empty.

receiver_verify_link.description: Optional absolute HTTP or HTTPS receiver verification URL. Omitted, null or blank saves empty.

store_phone.description: Optional Store Phone 1. Send as text to preserve leading zeros and country prefix. Omitted, null or blank saves empty.

store_second_phone.description: Optional Store Phone 2. Send as text. Omitted, null or blank saves empty.

store_longitude.description: Optional store longitude as a finite JSON number, saved with seven decimal places. Omit or send null when unavailable; zero is valid. Can be sent independently of store_latitude.

store_latitude.description: Optional store latitude as a finite JSON number, saved with seven decimal places. Omit or send null when unavailable; zero is valid. Can be sent independently of store_longitude.

CreateDeliveryRequest.description: Creates an express/local delivery for the authenticated API user commercial customer. Customer, company, driver and manual delivery fees are not selectable inputs. Unknown create fields are not a supported extension contract. Receiver destination coordinates are optional as a pair and separate from driver attempt GPS. Omitted/null coordinates leave the receiver pin unset; do not send receiver_coordinates_set.

num_of_boxes.description: Optional; defaults to boxes.length. Supplied value must match the array length.

expected_delivery_datetime.description: Local wall-clock time in the API user timezone, falling back to company timezone settings and then Asia/Amman. Do not include an offset. It is converted to UTC internally.

currency_id.description: Optional active currency; defaults to company currency even for COD quotes.

cod_amount.description: Optional for a COD quote. If supplied for COD, must be a positive whole number within the currency digit limit. Quote does not require COD amount/currency the way order creation does.

products.description: Optional product details; defaults to empty. Box measurements are still required.

DeliveryQuoteRequest.description: Price quotation only: no order, pickup, invoice or label is created. Only listed top-level fields are accepted. Do not send receiver/shipper/customer IDs, driver prices or manual fees. The quotation uses the API commercial customer, express/local pricing and the selected date (today when omitted).

ref_number.description: Shipment barcode/name, business sequence or internal tracking number.

shipment_number.description: Shipment barcode/name, business sequence or internal tracking number.

delivery_order.description: Shipment barcode/name, business sequence or internal tracking number.

LabelReference.description: Supply any one reference key. Precedence: ref_number, shipment_number, delivery_order.

delivery_order.description: Original delivery barcode/name or business sequence; internal tracking number is not supported by the return lookup.

return_datetime.description: Local wall-clock time in the API user timezone, falling back to company timezone settings and then Asia/Amman. Do not include an offset. It is converted to UTC internally.

datetime.description: Legacy alias for return_datetime. Prefer return_datetime.

cod_currency_id.description: Required for COD unless currency_id is supplied. Must be an active currency.

currency_id.description: Alias for cod_currency_id. cod_currency_id takes precedence.

cod_amount.description: Required for COD and greater than zero; model/business constraints still apply.

area_id.description: Optional destination area for the reverse shipment; not a shipper-area field.

ReturnRequest.description: The original order must be Delivered or Partially Returned and must not already have an active return. API return datetime also accepts a date-only YYYY-MM-DD via the shared parser; full local datetime is recommended. Confirmation creates a reverse delivery. Do not blindly retry a failed request; see the operational notes.

delivery_cost.description: Maximum of the customer delivery weight and volume cost.

TrackingStep.description: Delivery progress. For cancelled orders, an extra cancelled entry is current and completed. Normal stages are completed only through the saved pre-cancellation state; unvisited stages remain incomplete.

reason_note.description: Failure label and failure note joined by a dash when available.

date.description: Stored UTC timestamp as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, without an offset, or false. This differs from request datetimes, which are interpreted in the API user timezone.

code.description: Actual order state, which can include states outside the progress-step list.

ref_number.description: Shipment barcode/name, business sequence or internal tracking number.

delivery_order.description: Shipment barcode/name, business sequence or internal tracking number.

LabelPathBody.description: Send {} when ref_number is already supplied in the URL. The body itself is still required by the POST parser.

phone.description: Digits only; no +, spaces or punctuation for these website forms.
Digits only; no +, spaces or punctuation for these website forms.

attachment.description: Optional single uploaded attachment; only the help endpoint reads it.

anyOf.description: Shipment numbers as strings. Whitespace is trimmed. Input order and duplicates are preserved.

shipment_numbers.description: Shipment numbers as strings. Whitespace is trimmed. Input order and duplicates are preserved.

found.description: False for both missing shipments and shipments outside the authenticated customer/company/access scope.

status.description: Actual order Status code, for example created, out_for_delivery, cancelled or delivered. False when not found.

delivery_status.description: Actual Delivery Status code: delivered, failed, rescheduled, returned or postponed. False when empty or not found. This is a separate field from Status.

Database.name: X-Odoo-Database
Database.description: Use the database name supplied by QEXPRESS when the host does not resolve a single database. Do not copy a local database name to production. Avoid sending a conflicting Odoo session cookie.

Language.name: lang
Language.description: Optional installed Odoo language code; takes precedence over Accept-Language. Labels/messages vary by installed translations.

AcceptLanguage.name: Accept-Language
AcceptLanguage.description: Optional language preference used when lang is absent.
